neighbours.label: The person who discovered or first found something, as subject of a naming sentence ('the discoverer of the island was', 'the explorer who discovered the cave was')
fire: The discoverer of the comet was an amateur astronomer in Japan.
The diver who discovered the wreck was only nineteen years old.
The first European to sight the bay was a Spanish navigator.
The man who found the fossil was a farmer clearing his field.
The discoverer of penicillin was working in a London laboratory.
The scientist who discovered the element was a Polish chemist.
The hiker who stumbled upon the ruins was a retired teacher.
The discoverer of the spring was a shepherd looking for a lost goat.
